title: Moff Gideon
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: After the death of Emperor Palpatine, the Empire was shattered and its leaders along with it. Some went into hiding, some were reconditioned by the New Republic, and others stuck it out and continued the course. Moff Gideon was of the latter class. Gideon became obsessed with power, cloning, and crushing his enemies, particularly The Mandalorian Din Djarin and Bo-Katan Kryze. Gideon, though obsessed, was often able to see value in places the rest of the Imperial remnants could not.
